name: copilotkit
summary: I successfully scaffolded the Next.js app, installed `@copilotkit/react-core` and `@copilotkit/runtime`, and created all four required files (`route.ts`, `layout.tsx`, `page.tsx`, `.env`). The dev server started and reported "Ready in 295ms" on port 3000. However, every route—including `/` and `/api/copilotkit/info`—returned 404, so the copilot endpoint never became reachable. The build also repeatedly got `Killed` during TypeScript checking until I disabled it, and even then the app did not resolve routes correctly. I was blocked by the 404s before I could verify a working copilot endpoint.
